# Neufeld Institute

> > A Canadian non-profit educational organization founded by Dr. Gordon Neufeld offering 30+ attachment-based developmental courses for parents, educators, and professionals.

The Neufeld Institute is grounded in developmental science and the Neufeld Approach to child development, offering comprehensive parent education, professional training, and practitioner support. The organization provides courses in multiple languages through both live classes and online learning platforms, including specialized programs like the Sleep Studies certificate.

## Key Topics

- Neufeld Approach
- Attachment-based development
- Dr. Gordon Neufeld
